frequency.title: Is this a one-time or repeated booking?
frequency.windowTitle: Note: Repeated is only open during specific periods
frequency.windowMessage: It opens on December 1 (for January–June) and June 1 (for July–December). One-time booking is available anytime.
frequency.windowClosed: It opens on December 1 (for January–June) and June 1 (for July–December). It is not open right now. One-time booking is available anytime.
frequency.windowClosedWithDate: It opens on December 1 (for January–June) and June 1 (for July–December). It is not open right now; next opening is {{date}}. One-time booking is available anytime.

when.title: When is your booking?
when.endAfterStart: End time must be after start time

recurringWhen.title: Set up your weekly Repeated Booking

recurringWhen.sharedTimeBody: Choose First occurrence and weekday. Start Time and End Time are optional and only seed the timetable search.
recurringWhen.weekdayMismatch: End Date must fall on the same weekday as Start Date.
recurringWhen.usePeriodMismatch: Start Date and End Date must be in the same Jan-Jun or Jul-Dec use period.
recurringWhen.dateOrder: End Date must be on or after Start Date.

recurringWhen.roomsNeedDate: Choose First occurrence to see available rooms.

recurringConflicts.kindOccupancyBlockedBody: Another Rental already holds this room on this date.
recurringConflicts.kindMinistryBody: Another Ministry's booking holds this room on this date and can't be overridden.

recurringConflicts.kindWeeklyQuotaBody: You already have a Personal Rental booking that week; Personal Rentals allow one booking per week.
